audience.text: Java developers needing a lightweight, dependency-free library to inspect and modify PSD/PSB header and layer metadata without requiring Photoshop or rendering capabilities.

capabilities.text: Load PSD and PSB files from file paths or streams and read header properties including dimensions, color mode, compression, and channel count.
capabilities.title: Load PSD/PSB files

capabilities.text: Access layer properties such as name, visibility, opacity, blend mode, position, and clipping through `PsdImage.getLayers()`.
capabilities.title: Inspect layer metadata

capabilities.text: Modify layer metadata using `setName`, `setVisible`, and `setOpacity`, and write changes back without touching pixel data.
capabilities.title: Edit layer metadata

capabilities.text: Save files with raw-preserving strategy: unmodified sections are copied byte-for-byte, ensuring round-trip integrity.
capabilities.title: Preserve raw file content

capabilities.text: Retrieve image resource metadata via `getImageResources()`; payloads are preserved but not exposed.
capabilities.title: List image resources

capabilities.text: Parse RGB, CMYK, and indexed-color PSD files without requiring external color conversion tools.
capabilities.title: Handle multiple color modes

limitations.text: No rendering or pixel decoding: the library does not export to PNG/JPEG or rasterize content.
Seven setters always throw `UnsupportedOperationException`, including `setChannelInformation`, `setLayerMaskData`, and `setLayerBlendingRangesData`.
Layer names are saved as ASCII up to 255 characters; non-ASCII characters become `?` and longer names cause `RuntimeException`.
Image resources are read-only: `save(OutputStream)` on `PreservedResourceBlock` always throws `UnsupportedOperationException`.
Adding, removing, or reordering layers via `setLayers` is unsupported and may produce inconsistent files.
Load enforces strict header limits: channel count 1–56, bit depth 1/8/16/32, max dimensions 30000 (PSD) or 300000 (PSB).

problems_solved.text: Enables non-destructive structural editing of PSD/PSB files by exposing layer metadata and supporting raw-preserving save operations.
Provides a pure-Java solution for PSD/PSB parsing without external dependencies or native tool requirements.
Supports byte-exact round-trip preservation of unmodified file sections to maintain file integrity.

product_summary.text: Aspose.PSD FOSS for Java is an open-source Java library for reading and editing structural metadata of PSD and PSB files without rendering pixels.

uncertainties: Whether `getActiveLayer()` returns the first layer or the actual active layer stored in the file is unclear.
The exact behavior of `setColorMode` when used with non-RGB payloads is not specified beyond header rewriting.
The scope of `PsdLoadException` vs `RuntimeException` wrapping for `load(InputStream)` vs `load(String)` is not fully detailed.
Whether `getVersion()` reflects actual file version or is hardcoded to 6 is ambiguous.
The behavior of `setLayers` with identical arrays is documented but edge cases are not explored.
The handling of PSB-specific header fields beyond size limits is not explicitly described.
The exact set of compression types supported beyond RAW, RLE, and ZIP is not enumerated.
Whether `java.desktop` module is optional or required for non-indexed-color workflows is not clarified.

workflows.name: Build and test
workflows.text: Run `mvn package` to build and `mvn test` to execute the JUnit 5 test suite under `test/`.

workflows.name: Release workflow
workflows.text: Releases are built and published via `.github/workflows/maven-central-release.yml`.
